2016.title: Ruby Port of Pymesync
2016.short_description: TimeSync is the OSU Open Source Lab's time tracking system; a project that allows users to track their time spent on various projects and activities...
2016.description: TimeSync is the OSU Open Source Lab's time tracking system; a project that allows users to track their time spent on various projects and activities irrespective of the programming language and tools used by the project. The goal of this project will be to create ruby port of Pymesync ( a python module to interface with the TimeSync API ) which ultimately would serve as a Ruby Gem with the same functionality as that of pymesync. I will also create a ruby application from scratch using the Sinatra Framework that will use this ruby gem for serving the data. This ruby application application will have several features that provide visualizations for the user.
